summary: Independent audit of V2-06 repair cycle 33434778952. Objective: fix the 3 must-fix findings from audit 33416807677. Independent re-run of the full suite (608 tests) and typecheck both pass. Research Analytics Plane (PrivacyTransformPipeline, PrivacyReleaseGate, taxonomy, query budget, differential privacy, consent/jurisdiction policy, buyer contracts, audit/export log) is preserved with strict Operational Store / Research Analytics Store separation and no operational IDs/free text/join keys in analytics types.
